kept.title: Show what she actually got
kept.gist: After the rooftop and the radio call, open the screen: a spoken idea turning into a card. The chase was for a thought.
kept.why: from Tue 0:05: “opens up the device in her hands and then radios through”

board.hook: Everyone's chasing it. Nobody knows what.

kept.title: The device as a relay baton
kept.gist: One continuous run where the device is handed off at speed between different people, each adding a line before passing it on.
kept.visual_query: motion blur, outstretched hands, city pavement
kept.why: from Mon 0:40: “different hands and different people”

board.hook: It never stays in one hand.

kept.title: Four stages, four shots
kept.gist: Map the product-to-video chain onto exactly four shots, so the launch cut has one image per stage and nothing else.
kept.visual_query: clean desk, soft daylight, single object
kept.why: from Mon 0:40: “make the product, then the AI, and then the output”

kept.title: Separate ideas meeting on screen
kept.gist: Creators speak into the device in different places; their separate lines drift together on screen and lock into one connected idea.
kept.visual_query: different rooms, warm lamps, quiet voices
kept.why: from Mon 0:01: “the hook being that the ideas are connected into”

board.hook: Three people. One idea. Never met.

kept.title: Cold open on the radio line
kept.gist: Start on black with only the radio crackle and the words, then rewind fast through the chase to show how she got there.
kept.visual_query: black frame, radio static, night street
kept.why: from Tue 0:05: “radios through and says, I've got it.”
